name: Shantidoot Infra Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2019, Shantidoot Infra Services Ltd is in the business of undertaking construction contracts and work contracts. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SISL is an integrated construction and real estate development co., focused primarily on the construction and development of residential and commercial projects, in and around Bihar

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 182% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 46.8%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 47.7 to 112 days.
